title: Edit The Min & Max Value of Price Sliders
text:
## Edit The Min & Max Value of Price Sliders
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000032539
Specific Post Types, such as Properties, include price sliders in their search widgets to allow for the selection of value ranges. By default, the price slider for Properties features a minimum value of $0 and a maximum value of $5,000,000, as demonstrated below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12106337896/original/cbctGywSWc2lgKi1WvdcZvJQYoDXiceeEQ.png?1647363326 | alt: ]
Users may click these values and slide them horizontally to adjust the search range.
For example, the following image displays a search for a more specific range of values:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12106337894/original/Y5XixQISS2XDmT5Sin38VBK9yDEBuPMI9Q.png?1647363315 | alt: ]

## Updating Minimum and Maximum Slider Values
To modify the default minimum and maximum values for a price slider.

## Navigate to Post Settings
Log in to the Admin area of the website and navigate to My Content .
Click on Edit Post Settings .
Use the Post Type search tool to locate the specific Post Type or scroll down to the desired entry.
Click the Edit button.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174274852/original/OlyPUJJBh8YqB48eBAXiETE1271ro4Sb8A.png?1770299706 | alt: ]

## Adjust Slider Configuration
Within the General Settings tab, scroll down to Additional Settings to locate the Price Slider fields.
Select "Yes" to activate a price slider for this Post Type, or "No" to disable it.
Enter the starting value for the price slider. Use numerical characters only; do not include commas or periods.
Enter the ending value for the price slider. Use numerical characters only; do not include commas or periods.
Adjust the values to the desired range, then click Save Changes .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174275072/original/NKF3XgSTpsNuv_i4ChNuXfsH-kaRL832iQ.png?1770299890 | alt: ]

## Reviewing the Changes
The search widget for the modified Post Type will now reflect the updated minimum and maximum values:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12106339432/original/6SKPJokB7NzS8DN06AiXW4lK9bMegZfdpQ.png?1647365057 | alt: ]
